key_points: Cloud and AI segment revenue grew 45% YoY (22-quarter high), with AI products at a $7.3B annualized run rate and 12 consecutive quarters of triple-digit growth — a strong structural positive.
RMB 44.73B free cash flow burn last quarter is a material red flag, though likely driven by aggressive AI capex investment rather than operational deterioration.
Multiple sources (GuruFocus, SimplyWall.St) flag BABA as trading below fair value, providing a valuation floor.
Recent 4.3% rally and China tech rotation may be partially priced in, limiting near-term upside.
The $10.2B AI capital raise adds funding capacity but also dilution and execution risk considerations.
